name: dft-autopilot
description: Automate DFT computational chemistry (Quantum ESPRESSO / VASP / Gaussian) from chat, on your own HPC — SCNet, any Slurm cluster, or local.

qe_work_dir.title: Local: workspace dir
qe_work_dir.description: QE_WORK_DIR — where inputs/outputs are written for COMPUTE_PROVIDER=local. Absolute path.

qe_pseudo_dir.title: Local: pseudopotential dir
qe_pseudo_dir.description: QE_PSEUDO_DIR — flat dir of *.upf pseudos scanned by create_qe_input for COMPUTE_PROVIDER=local.

compute_provider.title: Compute backend
compute_provider.description: Where jobs run: scnet | slurm | local. Leave as 'local' to run on this machine.

mp_api_key.title: Materials Project API key
mp_api_key.description: For search_materials. Get one at https://next-gen.materialsproject.org/api

llm_api_key.title: LLM API key (optional)
llm_api_key.description: Only for server-internal LLM calls; the chat model is provided by your client. Usually leave blank.

slurm_host.title: Slurm: SSH host
slurm_host.description: e.g. user@login.cluster.edu or a ~/.ssh/config alias. Required for COMPUTE_PROVIDER=slurm.

slurm_modules.title: Slurm: env setup
slurm_modules.description: Shell commands to load engines, e.g. 'module load quantum-espresso/7.4' (semicolon-separated).

slurm_pseudo_dir.title: Slurm: remote pseudopotential dir
slurm_pseudo_dir.description: Remote QE pseudopotential dir (for pseudo_dir rewrite). Optional.

scnet_user.title: SCNet: user
scnet_user.description: Your own SCNet account username. Required for COMPUTE_PROVIDER=scnet.

scnet_hpc_url.title: SCNet: HPC URL
scnet_hpc_url.description: Your SCNet cluster's HPC API base URL.

scnet_efile_url.title: SCNet: EFile URL
scnet_efile_url.description: Your SCNet cluster's EFile API base URL.

scnet_qe_env_script.title: SCNet: QE env script
scnet_qe_env_script.description: Remote path to the QE environment init script.
